label: AMD
description: A configurable local AMD computer for development, data preparation, and smaller jobs.
tidbit: AMD is a processor brand, not one fixed configuration. An AMD CPU can be paired with graphics from another vendor; the CPU brand does not determine the separate GPU.
goodFor: Local development, debugging, data preparation, and experiments that fit the computer’s installed resources.
limitations: This is a generic configuration, not an identified processor. Core counts, RAM, NPU support, and GPU compatibility must be checked on the actual machine.
